assessment: Independent preliminary current-main Work Mode diagnostic
verdict_explanation: All five narrowly defined saved-state/public-response endpoint dimensions pass for each of 36 turns. Full procedural and context/compaction conformance is INCONCLUSIVE; missing traces are not PASS or proof of violation.

dimension_scopes.preservation: Authorized consequential meaning retained at the turn endpoint; where writes are paused/ungranted, appropriate public preservation proposal and unchanged saved state. No procedure-order claim.
dimension_scopes.correctness: Visible saved/public meaning, source/revision/profile/proposal/authority/evidence qualifications against captured inputs. Does not certify claimed tool execution.
dimension_scopes.authorization: Observed net file changes versus the exact current permitted action scope, including continuing maintenance and pauses. Does not certify no transient/outside writes.
dimension_scopes.dependencies: Visible supported blocking and readiness relations, limited risk acceptance, and no invented satisfaction of playback/release requirements.
dimension_scopes.continuation: Useful state/response for the request and safe later work; exact resume prompt required at delivery and reader request, not every no-op or historical question.
